capabilities: Render bibtex code blocks as formatted bibliography entries
Color entry headers with the vault accent color
disambiguation: It only restyles bibtex code blocks for reading; it does not manage a bibliography, import citations, or insert references.
extras: FAQ notes that after enabling the plugin or changing settings, affected notes must be closed and reopened or Obsidian restarted to see entries rendered.
problem: Raw BibTeX entries pasted into notes are dense and hard to read inside Obsidian.
summary: Renderer that displays BibTeX bibliography code blocks in a styled, readable card instead of raw citation markup.
